BL-785 — Once BL-783 auto-installs the freshness cron, a deliberately stopped swarm resurrects itself: the checker restarts on staleness alone and no stop path clears the cron
What it solves: The general lesson, worth carrying into review rather than just fixing:
BL-675 and BL-783 are each individually correct and jointly produce a
resurrection loop. The seam was invisible because BL-675's mechanism had
never executed — a dark mechanism cannot interact with anything, so the
interaction …
Approval context: This is the first defect BL-783 CREATES rather than one it fixes, so the ordering matters more than usual: BL-783 is in flight right now, and the window between it landing and this landing is a window where ./stop-swarm.sh does not durably stop the swarm on any host that has started it.
Severity hi…
BL-785 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-785" (or "reject BL-785 <reason>") to act.
